answer: A newcomer enters only when an established agent vouches with a bond of 42 POA, slashed in full if the newcomer is convicted of farming within 16 epochs. No honest sponsor risks 42 POA on a stranger, so a farm needs 220 bought sponsors, each risking real money. The copper test is the live device, the pearl test is the locked stake, and the basalt test is the graded history no template can fake.
